(583)oṃ ārya tā ra ye/srid zhi kun khyab rnam kun stong pa nyid/dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/shes rab phar phyin chos sku yum chen mo

tei:div.tei:p: (583)oṃ ārya tā ra ye/ srid zhi kun khyab rnam kun stong pa nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ shes rab phar phyin chos sku yum chen mo/ rje btsun 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ rnam dag padma drwa ba'i zhing khams su/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i spyan mnga' ba/ yid can mtha' dag bde bar dbugs 'byin mjad/ rje btsun 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po'i bye brag gis/ (584)gang 'dul cir yang shar ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi/ rnam rol sprul pa'i lha mo myur dpa' mo/ dbyangs can bsod nams mchog ster gtsug tor rgyal/ ku ru kulle 'jigs byed chen mo dang*/ gtum mo mi thub gzhan mi rgyal ba dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal nor ster dbang byed ma/ bkra shis don byed lha mo dgra dpung 'joms/ khro gnyer can mjad rab zhi 'bar ba'i 'od/ dpag med gnon ma rma bya che mo dang*/ mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod lo gyon la/ 'od zer (585)can ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ de ltar snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ byang chub sems 'byongs gang snang lha skur dag bskyed rdzogs don la rang byan tshud pa dang*/ yang dag lam gyi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen smon pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ mi dge sdig pa ma lus kun dag nas/ gzhan gyis sdang dang rmi lam ngan pa bral/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob par byin gyis rlobs/ mi khom brgyad du nam yang (586)mi skye zhing*/ rtag tu skye ba dran dang dbang po gsal/ tshul khrims rnam dag chos la yid gzhungs nas/ nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin pa las/ bsrung dang skyob dang sbed par mjad du gsol/ ma rungs dgra dang gdon bgegs 'tshe ba dang*/ dus mi 'chi dang rims dang dug gi nad/ ma lus zhi zhing dag par mjad nas kyang*/ mthar thug 'phags ma'i dgongs spyod mngon gyur shog
ces pa'ang bla ma sangs rgyas kyi ngor rgyal sras padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o/// /
